definitions.explanation: Renovating or remodeling a building, room, or vehicle's interior.

examples.japanese: {店|みせ}を{改装|かいそう}した。
{改装|かいそう}{中|ちゅう}のため{休業|きゅうぎょう}します。
{古|ふる}い{建物|たてもの}を{改装|かいそう}してカフェにした。
examples.english: We renovated an old building into a café.

notes:
{改装|かいそう} typically refers to interior renovation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {改装|かいそう}{中|ちゅう} (under renovation)
- {改装|かいそう}オープン (reopening after renovation)
- {全面|ぜんめん}{改装|かいそう} (complete renovation)
- {店舗|てんぽ}{改装|かいそう} (store renovation)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {改築|かいちく}: rebuilding, reconstruction (structural)
- {改造|かいぞう}: remodeling, modification
- {リフォーム}: reform, renovation (loanword)
